verdict.rationale: MotherDuck's docs say you can load data from object storage and query S3, GCS and Azure Blob Storage directly, with S3 credentials stored via CREATE SECRET. However, no cited evidence names the CSV, JSON or Parquet formats or shows a single documented bulk-load command. Missing for 10: explicit per-format (CSV/JSON/Parquet) load documentation, a concrete single-command bulk-load example, independent or hands-on corroboration.
